mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, campus_id, org_node_id, data_scope_type, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_internal_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status != 2

SELECT id, username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, campus_id, org_node_id, data_scope_type, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_internal_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status != 2 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, campus_id, org_node_id, data_scope_type, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_internal_user WHERE phone = #{phone} AND status != 2 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.name, u.status, u.data_scope_type, u.campus_id, c.name AS campus_name, u.org_node_id, o.name AS org_node_name, o.node_type AS org_node_type, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM sys_internal_user u LEFT JOIN sys_campus c ON c.id = u.campus_id LEFT JOIN sys_org_node o ON o.id = u.org_node_id
ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_internal_user (username, password, phone, name, avatar, status, must_change_password, data_scope_type, campus_id, org_node_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{user.username}, #{user.password}, #{user.phone}, #{user.name}, #{user.avatar}, #{user.status}, #{user.mustChangePassword}, #{user.dataScopeType}, #{user.campusId}, #{user.orgNodeId}, #{user.createdAt}, #{user.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_internal_user SET phone = #{user.phone}, name = #{user.name}, avatar = #{user.avatar}, data_scope_type = #{user.dataScopeType}, campus_id = #{user.campusId}, org_node_id = #{user.orgNodeId}, updated_at = #{user.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{user.id} AND status != 2
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.name, u.avatar, u.status, u.must_change_password, u.data_scope_type, u.campus_id, c.name AS campus_name, u.org_node_id, o.name AS org_node_name, o.node_type AS org_node_type, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM sys_internal_user u LEFT JOIN sys_campus c ON c.id = u.campus_id LEFT JOIN sys_org_node o ON o.id = u.org_node_id
AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.status != 2 /*DATA_SCOPE*/

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_internal_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND r.code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 1
